basis: Late treponemal infection; neurologic, cardiovascular and gummatous disease vary by subtype and do not uniformly characterize this umbrella.
Developmental defects of the abdominal body wall; herniation of abdominal organs does not establish intrinsic gastrointestinal damage across the group.
Autoimmune superficial blistering skin disease; oral ulcers occur in only 5-29%, and associated systemic lupus is a separate disease.
Defining caudal/digital malformations, sensorineural deafness and intellectual disability; each supported by frequent phenotypes. Cryptorchidism has no axis.
Mesenchymal neoplasm arising in the uterine corpus, a reproductive organ; smooth muscle histology does not imply skeletal muscle disease.
Mature B-cell lymphoma arising in the CNS; neural origin and haematologic malignancy apply, with the required lymphoma mechanism axis.
Defined by multiple enchondromas and cutaneous vascular tumors; vascular malformations and thrombosis support cardiovascular involvement. Other tumors are separate diseases.
Peroxisomal disorder with cerebral malformation and liver disease; cataract in 1/1 supports ocular damage. Skeletal abnormalities omitted by cap.
Compression of the iliac vein impairs venous drainage and predisposes to local thrombosis; no other organ directly affected commonly.
Defined by skeletal malformations, hair/sweat gland dysplasia and oligodontia. Cardiac defects are occasional; renal and ocular frequencies are unestablished.
Corneal thinning and rupture define disease; joint connective tissue dysfunction occurs in 80-99% and hearing loss in 30-79%. Skin injury is not common.
Neoplasms defined by reproductive gonadal tissue differentiation; neither a specific extra-gonadal site nor hormone dysfunction characterizes the umbrella.
Immune-complex or complement-mediated glomerular injury. Secondary hypertension does not establish direct vascular injury; ocular deposits are very rare.
Umbrella disease concept explicitly located in the ear; infection is only one subtype.
Malignant neoplasm arising in the diencephalon; endocrine dysfunction is not established across its subtypes.
Skin/fascial fibrosis and joint contractures define disease; myopia occurs in 6/8. Reflux in 4/8 does not establish direct gastrointestinal injury; neuropathy is 2/8.
Sclerosing metaphyseal bone dysplasia; global developmental delay in 1/1 supports neurologic involvement, although intellectual disability and seizures are otherwise occasional.
Heart failure due to rheumatic, immune-mediated cardiac disease; congestion alone does not establish direct injury to other organs.
Hormone resistance and AHO skeletal dysplasia; cognitive/nerve impairment and cataracts each 30-79%. Skin ossification (2/2) and enamel defects (30-79%) omitted by cap.
Benign glandular proliferation of the prostate, a reproductive organ; urinary tract injury is not intrinsic or established as common.
Carcinoma arising in the supraglottic larynx, included in the airway axis.
Degenerative, atrophic disease of the cornea, supported by its corneal degeneration parent.
Pyruvate metabolism defect causing lactic acidosis; developmental delay in 2/2 and cerebral MRI abnormalities in 30-79% support direct neurologic dysfunction.
Inherited BEST1-related retinal degeneration; the neurologic ancestor does not establish disease outside the eye.
Hereditary optic atrophy with visual loss and optic disc pallor in 2/2; optic nerve disease belongs to the ocular axis.
